author: MidnightVision
title: The end of my love
content: This game has single-handedly ruined my life view due to its horrendous rng based gameplay and the hours I’ve wasted playing it. I’ve never been met with such displeasure upon opening a game and playing its levels. Satan himself came onto this Earth as a game developer and casted this treacherous and abysmal game onto any victim that touches it. I’ve never had as much hatred and disgust for anything in the world as much as I have in this. I’ve considered myself a loving and kind-hearted person throughout my life, but this game has broken me. Years of good deeds, strong bonds, and hope for my future has gone and demolished in seconds upon playing this game. I’ve only played this game for monetary gain from a third party, and that could explain my frustration, but nonetheless, it doesn’t excuse this half baked attempt at a puzzle/strategy game. It piggybacks off of previous success, and how many powerups you have. Some levels become 3x harder with them, while some are neigh impossible with them. This randomness causes me to want to do things I can not discuss in a mere review. The punishment for losing is only a deterrence from playing this godawful game. A single loss grants you nothing, except another chance to pray, pray that you get hope to beat the level. It’s undeniably bad game design to be left with pennies after a loss, with no notable gain. I’ve never been more ashamed in humanity until now, and I keep up to date politically. Developers and creators of this game, I end this review with a farewell, I hope to never see this product again in my life. You’ve ruined my day, and left a permanent mark on my brain. Adieu.
